text.p: - Slovenian Primoz Peterka won both ski jumping events over the weekend in Switzerland's Engelberg, that extended Peterka's overall lead in World Cup standings.
- Demand for Slovenian wine rose 23.5 percent in 1996 compared to 1995, and 81.2 percent compared to a decade ago.
- Slovenia's troubled car part producer Cimos said losses in last year reached 7.5 billion tolars ($52.4 million).

- Slovenia's Democratic Party, which did not win any seats in parliament after November's general election said the only solution for Slovenia's complicated political situation would be a premature election in the autumn.
- Famous Italian tenor Luciano Pavarotti will perform in Ljubljana for the first time on July 3 and 4, cultural organizers in Ljubljana said.
- A delegation of representatives of Finland's parliament will visit Slovenia on Monday.
- The number of Slovenian border crossings by October 1996 rose by eight percent compared to the same period a year before, authorities said.
